_about: The things of the world that came at a known time (#39; src/core/origins.js; docs/WORLD.md). A thing has the first year when it was in Vietnam (from: a year, negative before the Common Era), the words for it (vi: in the language files and the lines of people; en), and the sources. The world of a region has only the things whose year is not after the year of the region (year in data/world/regions.json): no house, field, market, or line of text has a thing before its year. A thing with no year (from: null) came from far away at a time that we did not check yet: it does not appear in the world until it has a year with a source.

maize.note: Maize came from the Americas. A legend says Phùng Khắc Khoan brought it back from China in 1597; Lê Quý Đôn (Vân đài loại ngữ) says Trần Thế Vinh brought it from the Qing in the Kangxi years, 1662 to 1723. The year here is the earlier one.

coin.note: The first coins of Vietnam were the Thái Bình Hưng Bảo of the Đinh dynasty (968 to 981). For two more centuries the common people traded mostly by barter. The world of the Hùng Kings trades by barter only (#26). The word đồng alone is not here: it also means a field and bronze.
